scope: Initial declared freestanding C99 subset compiled and tested inside real KVM; not a general toolchain or installed authority qualification

implementation.authorization: Existing original PAM, finite ExecuteGenerated grant, acquisition resource generations, revocation and physical drainage; receipts remain inert data
implementation.elf_hardening: static-elf-stack-v1 preserves original compiler bytes, separately records bounded hardening and runnable digest, and retains the strict static ELF validator
implementation.failure_semantics: Compilation failures explicitly mark tests not run; exit, timeout and output limits cannot become passing tests through clipping. Raw-v1 buffered overflow after exit refuses completion without inventing a signal.

verification.apparmor: Offline parse passed; missing host kernel interface warning retained, not loaded or enforced

dependency_delivery.source_chain: Signed noble InRelease -> universe source Sources -> exact pinned tcc source archives
dependency_delivery.relink_kit: Mandatory application object, libtcc archive/header, corresponding compiler source and Debian patch archive, provenance, recipe and full license texts

retained_failed_attempts.reason: Ignored source-cut helper replaced a profile substring in the wrong order; product routing was correct. Failed cut retained and corrected in a new immutable cut.

Strict validator rejected original TinyCC ELF lacking explicit nonexecutable stack; production now preserves original compiler bytes and explicitly records a separate bounded hardening transformation.
Real buffered-output tests exposed false-success clipping after child exit; fixed in both compiler test and existing raw runners and retested in KVM.
